source_direct_findings: The official Qwen3-ASR family supports German transcription.
The 0.6B HF checkpoint is available as a local safetensors model and is not dependent on a remote inference provider.
The current HF model card documents explicit language forcing and context/hotword prompting.
The model.safetensors payload is unchanged from the verified 6aa69c3 source lineage and is published with SHA-256 d3f212dd20abecd315d830bc54ae3865e56ebfc3276484e57b771288ba27fd35.

frankenstein_binding.role: German local ASR baseline/challenger against Nemotron 3.5 Streaming 0.6B and donor Whisper

next_gate: After the clay-direct-dev hardware/disk receipt is observed, quarantine-download this exact revision, recompute model/tokenizer hashes inside the sandbox, then execute the same German room-audio receipt harness used for Nemotron and Whisper.
